## Plan + test matrix

The defect (per the contract's evidence tables): P32-era camreg ingests
asserted `camera_operator` pointing at the registry *publisher* (74.2% of
camreg rows) and `edge.valid_from` carried `1970-01-01` placeholders; OSM
subjects had no operator edges (the evidence is a free-text tag, not an
entity) and no explicit unknown state. CP-7 asks for roles + time on edges;
CONF-06 the confidence surface on those edges.

1. **Sqitch `role_edges`** — reshape the empty `entity_role` table (spec §C.5
   sketch — zero hosted rows, no writer today) into the role-edge schema:
   surrogate PK `entity_role_id`, nullable `actor_id` (NULL only for the
   explicit-unknown marker), `valid_from_kind`/`valid_to_kind` (closed kind
   vocabulary incl. `undated`), `observed_at`, `asserted_by`, `supersedes`
   self-FK, `superseded_by_claim` FK, `input_digest`, `sys_period`; closed
   `role` vocabulary CHECK = the 14 `OrganizationRole` values ∪ the §12.4
   fourteen ∪ `maintainer`, `operator_unknown`; epoch-zero `NOT VALID` CHECKs
   (`lower(valid_period)` ≠ 1970-01-01; `observed_at` > 1970-01-01 when set —
   `NOT VALID` binds new writes while existing rows wait a named VALIDATE
   follow-up, per the `entity_typing_mobility_check` precedent). `relationship`
   gains `supersedes` + the same epoch-zero `NOT VALID` CHECKs. Two
   SECURITY-DEFINER close functions (`close_superseded_entity_roles`,
   `close_superseded_relationships`) pattern `close_superseded_resolutions` —
   sys_period close on open rows only, granted to `sig_materialize`; the
   materializer gets INSERT+SELECT on `entity_role` (it is off the §37 public
   surface, like `relationship`).
2. **`db/src/db/organization_roles.py`** — add `MAINTAINER` + predicate maps
   (`maintainer`, `maintained_by`; `published_by`/`listed_by`/`published_by_source`
   → PUBLISHER); `EDGE_ROLE_VOCABULARY` (role-CHECK union incl.
   `operator_unknown`); `UNKNOWN_STATE_FOR_ROLE` (`operator` → `operator_unknown`)
   and `ABSENCE_PREDICATES` (`operator_absent` → `operator` slot).
3. **`reconcile/materialize.py`** —
   a. `SharingObservation.observed_at` becomes `Optional`; undated claims never
      produce `date(1970,1,1)`. `edge_row` on `observed_at=None` → unbounded
      `valid_period`, `valid_from_kind='undated'`, `observed_at=NULL` (the
      explicit undated marker); dated edges keep the reconciler's start kind
      (SIG-RECON-036: a snapshot never proves a start). Digest covers
      kind+bounds so old 1970 rows produce new digests → superseding rows.
   b. `relationship` supersession: a materialized row whose `(from,to,edge_type)`
      differs in digest from the open row supersedes it — the open row's
      sys_period closes via `close_superseded_relationships`, the new row's
      `supersedes` links it. GQ-15's "zero open duplicate edges" holds.
   c. `materialize_role_edges` — new materializer over current tier-0 claims with
      `object_entity` + a role predicate (`ROLE_OF_PREDICATE` ∩ entity-ref
      roles) plus `operator_absent` absence claims. Per `(subject, role-slot)`:
      claims order by (evidenced date `valid_lower|observed_at` else
      `sys_period` lower, claim_id); within one claim lineage
      (`claim_lineage.source_id`, NULL → own lineage) successive *distinct*
      states supersede (the earlier row closes at the later claim's date,
      `superseded_by_claim` = the later claim); explicit `revises_claim`/
      `retraction_of` closes the revised claim's state cross-lineage;
      same-lineage same-state claims merge into one edge's evidence set;
      cross-lineage disagreement stays concurrent (both edges live — never
      silently reconciled, §3.1). `operator_absent` later than operator
      evidence closes the operator edge and opens `operator_unknown`.
      Idempotent on `input_digest`; a re-run is `+0`.
   d. `read_materialized_role_edges` + `operator_state` readers.
   e. CLI `sig-reconcile materialize-role-edges` — `--dry-run` default +
      `--apply`, `--subject`, `--jurisdiction`, `--limit`, `--batch-size`,
      `--role`, report JSON (the `lineage-rematerialize` shape).
4. **Emitter corrections** —
   a. `connectors/data_driven.py` + `sources.toml` `[eff_release]`: commit
      `coverage_from=2016-01-01`, `coverage_to=2018-01-01`,
      `coverage_edtf="2016/2017"` + `publisher_label`; the emitted claims
      carry `valid_from`/`valid_to`/`valid_edtf`+`exact` kinds (the
      historical window the data covers), plus a `published_by` claim per
      agency (provenance role — literal, never an entity-ref).
   b. `connectors/osm.py`: carry the element `timestamp` into raw +

      `published_by` claim per element ("OpenStreetMap contributors");
      `operator_stated` stays literal per its definition (resolved operator

   c. `connectors/atlas.py`: capture upstream `editingInfo.lastEditDate` /

      `capture_metadata` (recorded provenance — never a `valid_from` guess).
5. **`ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml`** — register `published_by`
   (provenance role predicate, literal, never_resolve); sqitch
   `vocab_published_by` change seeds `vocab_predicate` + the 20-genre
   `directness_matrix` row (registry/D1, run/D3, others/D6) following the
   `vocab_geometry_defect` precedent.
6. **ADR** — the role-succession model (within-lineage ordering, explicit
   `revises`/`retraction` cross-lineage, concurrent cross-source disagreement)
   and the entity_role PK reshape are a new ADR with `## Revisit trigger`.

## Implementation notes

- **`entity_role` reshape** (`db/deploy/role_edges.sql`): the surrogate
  `entity_role_id` PK replaces the §C.5 composite natural PK — a primary-key
  column cannot be NULL and `actor_id` MUST be NULL for the
  `operator_unknown` marker (SIG-ONTO-028). Natural uniqueness moved to the
  partial `input_digest` UNIQUE (the `relationship`/`entity_type_decision`
  posture). The table carried zero rows and no writer anywhere — the reshape
  is additive-safe; recorded in ADR-214.
- **`relationship`** gained `supersedes` + the same epoch-zero `NOT VALID`
  CHECKs; `valid_period`/`observed_at`/`asserted_by`/`sys_period`/`evidence_claim`
  were already present.
- **Bound-kind vocabulary** extended with `undated` — the explicit
  no-evidenced-date marker; an undated edge is `tstzrange(NULL,NULL,'[)')`
  (unbounded), `valid_from_kind='undated'`, `observed_at IS NULL`.
- **The one sanctioned mutation**: `close_superseded_entity_roles` /
  `close_superseded_relationships` — SECURITY DEFINER, `search_path=pg_catalog`,
  close only `upper_inf(sys_period)` rows. `sig_materialize` holds
  SELECT+INSERT+EXECUTE and never UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE (asserted by
  `test_materialize_role` + `test_the_closure_functions_are_materializer_only`).
- **`materialize_role_edges`**: per `(subject, role-slot)` the claim list
  orders by (evidenced date → `sys_period` lower, claim_id); within one
  `claim_lineage.source_id` successive distinct states close the prior episode
  at the later claim's date (`superseded_by_claim` names it); explicit
  `revises_claim`/`retraction_of` closes the targeted state cross-lineage;
  open same-state episodes merge across lineages into one corroborated edge;
  closed episodes stay per-lineage rows; cross-lineage disagreement stays
  concurrent (never silently reconciled, §3.1). `operator` and
  `operator_unknown` share the `operator` slot (`role_slot`), so absence
  evidence and operator evidence supersede each other.
- **`materialize_sharing_edges`**: observations' `observed_at` is `None` for
  undated claims (the `date(1970,1,1)` fallback is gone); `edge_input_digest`
  covers `observed_at` + bound kinds, so a pre-P35.26 1970 row digests
  differently → it is closed as a superseded version and the undated row
  lands (the one-time correction wave the queued rematerialize leg runs).
  Changed evidence, changed claims and disappeared evidence all close open
  rows; readers filter `upper_inf(sys_period)`.
- **Emitters**: EFF Data Driven stamps the release's covered window
  (`valid_from=2016-01-01`, `valid_to=2018-01-01`, `valid_edtf=2016/2017`,
  `exact` kinds — from `data_driven_vocab.toml`, never a code constant) +
  a `published_by` claim per agency; OSM carries the element `timestamp` as
  `element_timestamp` → `observed_at` on every tag claim, stamps
  `operator_absent` + emits `published_by="OpenStreetMap contributors"` per
  element; Atlas records `editingInfo.lastEditDate`/capture `Last-Modified`
  as `upstream_modified_at` provenance (never a `valid_from` guess).
  `operator_stated`/`operator_qid` stay literal per their definitions — the
  operator entity crosswalk is the CP-10 row, not this one.
- **`published_by` registered**: `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` (literal,
  single, GLACIAL/3652d, max_support, `never_resolve`) → regenerated
  `ontology/generated/**` → `vocab_published_by` sqitch change seeds
  `vocab_predicate` + the 20-genre `directness_matrix` row
  (`ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, INSERT-only); `ROLE_OF_PREDICATE` maps
  `published_by`/`listed_by`/`published_by_source` → PUBLISHER (provenance —
  never an entity-ref role).
- **ADR-214** recorded (role edges, honest time, recorded supersession);
  indexed in `docs/adr/README.md`, `ADR_TRIGGERS.csv`, Appendix F of the
  spec-src (BUILD.sh byte-identical) and `BACKLOG.csv` BL-085.

## Self-review

Pass 1 (mechanical):

- `git diff` reviewed file-by-file; ruff format/lint + mypy clean.
- **Bug found + fixed**: `db/revert/role_edges.sql` dropped
  `entity_role_pkey` before the dependent `entity_role_supersedes_fkey` —
  `sqitch revert` failed (`cannot drop constraint … other objects depend on
  it`, caught by `test_intake_pg`'s revert drill). Reordered: FK first.
- **Bug found + fixed**: `materialize_role_edges` cast
  `c.subject_id > %s::uuid` and passed raw subject strings into
  `ANY(%s::uuid[])` — a non-uuid subject (e.g. `osm:node/1001`) would abort
  the pass / the entity-FK insert. The read now filters non-uuid subjects
  out of the groups entirely (`_is_uuid` — their claims stay evidence, no
  edge can exist), and the pagination predicate is a plain text comparison.
- mypy found `ep` reused with two types in `_episodes` → renamed `tgt_ep`.
- `tests/db/test_p31_6_access_edges.py` pinned `valid_from_kind='unknown'`
  for the undated case — updated to `undated` (the deliberate new semantic).
- `tests/db/test_quality_probe.py` inserted a literal 1970 edge — updated to
  a real historical bound + measured count 4→3 (the CHECK makes the epoch
  seed unwritable).
- Filename collision (`tests/db/test_role_edges.py` vs
  `tests/reconcile/test_role_edges.py` — same pytest module name) → renamed
  the db file `test_role_edge_schema.py`.
- `check_live_claims` flagged four assert-word segments in this ledger —
  reworded `live` → `open`/`current` where the sentence is a code-behavior
  description, not a production-state claim.
- `check_spec_src` required ADR-214 in Appendix F — added to the spec-src
  appendix and rebuilt (`BUILD.sh` byte-identical).
- `check_backlog`/`test_no_future_date_literals` required the BL-085 home
  row + `history.policy` allow entries for the two `sqitch.plan`
  `planned_at` stamps — added per the P35.25 precedent.

Pass 2 (design):

- **Supersession semantics re-checked**: the prior open row's `valid_to` is
  never rewritten in place — the closing state's *desired* row carries the
  corrected bounds + `superseded_by_claim`, and the open old version is
  sys_period-closed as a superseded version (belief succession). Both edges
  stay readable; the chain is `supersedes`/`superseded_by_claim`.
- **Scoped closing**: a filtered run (`--subject`/`--jurisdiction`/`--slot`)
  only manages the (subjects, slots) it actually read — it can never close
  rows outside its read scope.
- **Digest coverage**: `supersedes` (the row link) is deliberately NOT in
  the digest — identity is content, not chain position; `superseded_by_claim`
  IS (a differently-closed state is different content). A re-run over
  unchanged claims is +0 by the partial UNIQUE + the live-digest match.
- **Provenance-role claims never edge**: `_ROLE_EDGE_PREDICATES` is
  `ROLE_OF_PREDICATE ∩ ENTITY_REF_ROLES` — `PUBLISHER`/`HOST` are excluded at
  the taxonomy level, so `published_by`/`camera_registry_publisher` can
  never mint an `entity_role` row regardless of `object_entity`.
- `entity_role` stays off the §37 public read surface (no
  `sig_read_public` grant — `test_public_read_allowlist` extended).

- **In-memory `observation_time` sentinel**: the resolver's
  `_UNDATED = date(1970,1,1)` remains the pre-ADR-104 in-memory sentinel
  marking undated claims HISTORICAL — it is never persisted to an edge row
  (the edge paths write `undated`/NULL). Out of scope: it is resolver
  semantics, not an edge date.
- **`db/occurrences.py` `UNDATED_DATE`** — the claim-occurrence model's own
  pre-existing 1970 convention on a non-edge table; unchanged (not an edge
  surface).
- **Pre-existing local-only failures** (unrelated to this row; the base
  `1f0e5df` fails identically on this machine):
  `tests/unit/test_p34_18_aliases.py` — the gitignored handle list makes the
  rekey-verify tests run locally; P34.39a's committed build records carry
  recorded handle mentions at the base tip (32 hits) — a P34.18-family
  residue, never touchable by this row (append-only disclosed history; CI
  skips — the list is gitignored).
  `tests/connectors/test_secrets.py` needs `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` exported
  (CI supplies `vars.SIG_GCP_PROJECT`; local runs arm it manually).
- **Stale-slot closing is read-scoped**: a (subject, slot) whose claims all
  leave the live read surface keeps its open row — a bounded run can never
  distinguish "never read" from "evidence gone"; the unfiltered rematerialize
  leg is where full stale-closing runs.
- **`operator` entity crosswalk**: `operator_stated`/`operator_qid` stay
  literal claims (CP-10 row), so OSM operator tags do not yet mint operator
  edges — the unknown-vs-asserted state is still first-class via
  `operator_absent`.
